title: Composable Transform Tool for Aggregator
description: aggregator: The transform tool should by default have translate and rotate on (currently they are exclusive and not composable). remove scale because it doesnt apply to existing building elements.
summary: Fixed aggregator end-to-end boot failure caused by stale generated/session.ts from a concurrent sourcing dev run: the shell loaded the sourcing plugin while Vite still baked appId puzzle3d-play, so puzzle3d-play was missing from the loaded manifest. Added resolvePlaygroundBoot in framework-core to prefer the Vite-baked variant and rebuild plugin rows from the generated catalog when session.ts is stale; wired os-dev react boot and wgpu boot through it; regenerated aggregator session.ts.
